school.mottoReflection: We encourage students to work with dedication, uphold the dignity of every person, and share the light of knowledge with their communities.
school.mission: To promote inclusive education, providing the quality of education, encouraging learners to innovate by enhancing practical skill and stressing the spiritual moral development.

about.title: A legacy of scientific excellence
about.description: Founded in 1952, G.S. Busogo I - Saint Benoît is a Catholic Marist Day School committed to science, humanities, faith, and moral discipline.

about.faithText: Marist values centered on service, humility, and character.

curriculum.title: Two pathways for Catholic Marist day learners
curriculum.description: Our Catholic Marist Day School nurtures scientific curiosity, human understanding, and strong moral character.
